answer: Require each identity to hold a small refundable stake on three independent chains, like a lotus rooted in separate ponds. A lone agent parks a little capital and earns it back. A farm must fund every fake on all three chains, and the funding graph acts as a prism splitting one source into many, revealing clones that share a funder — they stand on a ledge of slashed stakes. Spreading capital across chains turns cloning into a traceable, expensive habit.
